scoring_justification: Activation enthalpies are recomputed from the agent's CSV curves (T1); transition pressures and band gaps are compared to paper‑reported hidden gold with tolerances (T0).

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference gold values for all scored quantities (transition pressures, activation enthalpies, band gaps).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Phys. Rev. B 65, 224115 (2002): transition pressures from Section III.A (p_t=19.3 GPa B3LYP, 11.4 GPa LDA), activation enthalpies from Section III.A text (0.15 eV Pmm2, 0.50 eV R3m at B3LYP p_t; 0.17 eV Pmm2, 0.54 eV R3m at LDA p_t), band gaps from Table II (4.8, 1.6, 1.1 eV at B3LYP p_t).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values for the same quantities, conditions, and units that the agent is asked to reproduce.

outputs.description: Equilibrium transition pressures from B3LYP and LDA equation‑of‑state fits.
Enthalpy profiles along Pmm2 and R3m pathways at B3LYP equilibrium pressure. The checker recomputes activation enthalpies (max of each curve) and verifies the Pmm2 < R3m trend.
Enthalpy profiles along Pmm2 and R3m pathways at LDA equilibrium pressure. Same checking logic as the B3LYP file.
Band gaps of zinc blende, Pmm2 intermediate (z=0.35), and rocksalt structures at the B3LYP equilibrium pressure.

output_contract.notes: Crystal structures are fully defined by their space groups and can be generated from standard crystallographic data; no external structure file is needed. All calculations are pure DFT and do not require wet‑lab inputs. Tolerances for the hidden gold are set wide enough to accommodate legitimate toolchain spread while still excluding random guesses.

steps.description: Both B3LYP and LDA transition pressures must be within ±2 GPa of the paper's values to earn full credit.
Activation enthalpies recomputed from the CSV: max of Pmm2 and R3m curves. Score 0.5 for Pmm2_max < R3m_max, 0.25 each for being within ±0.1 eV of the paper's reported values.
Same logic as B3LYP activation file, at LDA equilibrium pressure.
All three band gaps must be within ±0.5 eV of the paper's values to earn full credit.
